categories.main_business_segments: Hunan Jinbo Carbon Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of advanced carbon-based composite materials and products. Its main business segments serve strategic emerging industries including photovoltaic (solar), semiconductor, transportation, lithium battery, and hydrogen energy sectors. The company also operates subsidiaries focused on hydrogen energy technology, carbon ceramic composites, and carbon-based materials research.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies such as carbon fiber web formation, needle-punching composite technology, rapid chemical vapor deposition, high-purity coating preparation, and high-temperature purification. It specializes in low-cost preparation of carbon/carbon (C/C) composites and carbon ceramic composites using chemical vapor deposition and liquid impregnation methods. Key innovations include high-purity carbon/tantalum carbide heat field components, flexible carbon-based bipolar plates, and roll-to-roll carbon paper production for fuel cells.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading manufacturers in photovoltaic silicon crystal pulling furnaces, semiconductor crystal growth, new energy vehicles, lithium battery anode materials, and hydrogen fuel cell components. The company maintains strategic partnerships with top-tier clients such as LONGi Green Energy, TCL Zhonghuan, Jinko Solar, BYD, GAC Aion, and others. Its products are widely used in solar energy, semiconductor manufacturing, automotive braking systems, lithium-ion battery production, and hydrogen energy applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant sales in regions including North China, Northwest, Central China, East China, Southwest, South China, and Northeast China. It also has a presence in overseas markets through sample deliveries and cooperation with international automotive OEMs. The headquarters and main production facilities are located in Yiyang, Hunan Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hunan Jinbo Carbon operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of advanced carbon-based composite materials and components that serve downstream industries such as photovoltaic, semiconductor, automotive, lithium battery, and hydrogen fuel cell manufacturers. It also engages in upstream R&D and equipment development to support its production processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in advanced carbon-based composite materials, focusing on low-cost scalable production, product diversification, and application expansion across multiple strategic sectors. R&D efforts emphasize new product development in carbon ceramic brake discs, lithium battery heat field components, photovoltaic heaters, porous carbon materials, and fuel cell components. It maintains a high R&D investment ratio (~17% of revenue) and operates multiple provincial-level research centers and a national postdoctoral research station.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of advanced carbon-based composite materials and related products to industrial customers. The company employs a direct sales model, fulfilling customized orders and providing integrated solutions including design, manufacturing, and technical services. It also earns investment income from equity holdings and financial asset management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer and supplier of carbon-based composite materials for photovoltaic and semiconductor heat field components, holding a significant market share in China. It is recognized as a national 'specialized and innovative' enterprise and a manufacturing 'single champion' for its products. Competitors include other advanced materials suppliers in the carbon composites and new energy sectors, but Jinbo Carbon maintains competitive advantages through proprietary technologies and strategic customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 537 million, a 49.9% decline from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 815 million. Total assets stood at RMB 6.25 billion, with a decrease of 12.8% year-over-year. The company experienced a significant profit decline due to reduced downstream demand, price drops, and impairment losses. Despite this, it continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion, aiming for long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jinbo Carbon emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies enabling low-cost, high-performance carbon-based composite materials with superior purity, mechanical strength, and thermal stability. Its products offer enhanced durability, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness for critical applications in photovoltaics, semiconductors, automotive braking, lithium batteries, and hydrogen fuel cells. The company’s integrated R&D and production platform, along with strong customer partnerships, provide differentiated value through customized solutions and continuous innovation.
